[Verse 1]
[D]Polar [A]opposites don't
[Bm]push [G]away, It's the same
[D]on the [A]weekends as the
[G]rest of the [D]days. And I know,
[D]I should [A]go but I would
[Bm]probably [G]stay, and that's all
[D]you can [A]do about
[G]somethings. [D]

[Chorus]
[D]I'm [A]tryin'.
[G]I'm [D]tryin' to,
[D]drink [A]away the part of the day that
[G]I cannot sleep [D]away.
[D]I'm [A]tryin'.
[G]I'm [D]tryin' to,
[D]drink away [A]the part of the day that I
[G]cannot sleep [D]away.

[Solo]
[D]  [A]
[Bm]  [G]
[D]  [A]
[G]  [D]

[Verse 2]
[D]Two one eyed [A]dogs, they're
[Bm]lookin' at [G]stereos. HiFi gods
[D]try so [A]hard
[G]to make their [D]cars low to the ground.
[D]These [A]vibrations,
[Bm]oil it [G]steep. Primer grey
[D]is the [A]colour when you're done
[G]dyin'. [D]

[Chorus]
[D]I'm [A]tryin'.
[G]I'm [D]tryin' to,
[D]drink [A]away the part of the day that
[G]I cannot sleep [D]away.
[D]I'm [A]tryin'.
[G]I'm [D]tryin' to,
[D]drink away [A]the part of the day that I
[G]cannot sleep [D]away.
